scope: cell lysates were obtained by centrifugation and loaded consecutively on spin columns (Pierce) containing streptavidin-coated beads prewashed with lysis buffer 1 (Pierce) and biotinylated proteins were enriched.
Possible protein-protein interactions were determined by HA-immunoprecipitation followed by label-free mass-spectrometry.

For proteomic analysis of the immunoprecipitated proteins, the cysteine bonds were reduced on beads with 5 mM Tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine (TCEP) for 30 mins at 37 °C followed by alkylation with 10 mM iodoacetamide. Beads were then resuspended in digestion buffer containing sequencing grade modified trypsin (Pierce) at 37 °C overnight.
